title: Shyam Premi SN
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm festive colours, glowing diyas, vertical friendly centred composition, no text, no letters, no writing
endline: Apne parivaar ko bhejein 🙏 | Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN
mantra_source: Dhanvantari ji ka laghu mantra (Dhanteras / Dhanvantari Jayanti par jap)

scenes.prompt: Bhagwan Dhanvantari, the four-armed form of Vishnu, holding a golden pot of amrit, a conch, a chakra and medicinal herbs, serene gentle smile, standing on a pink lotus above a shining ocean of milk, soft golden divine aura, rows of lit clay diyas in the foreground
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly, the golden aura gently pulses and the camera slowly pushes in; the face stays still and serene
scenes.line: भगवान धन्वंतरि आपको उत्तम स्वास्थ्य दें
scenes.tts: शुभ धनतेरस! भगवान धन्वंतरि आपको उत्तम स्वास्थ्य दें।
scenes.sub: Shubh Dhanteras! Bhagwan Dhanvantari aapko uttam swasthya dein.

scenes.prompt: Maa Lakshmi seated on a large pink lotus, four arms, red saree with gold border, gold ornaments, beside Shri Ganesh ji with his mouse, a decorated home altar with marigold garlands, a shining brass kalash and many lit clay diyas, festive night
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the faces stay still and serene, the diya flames flicker and a few marigold petals drift in the foreground
scenes.line: माँ लक्ष्मी और गणेश जी की कृपा बनी रहे
scenes.tts: माँ लक्ष्मी और गणेश जी की कृपा आपके परिवार पर बनी रहे।
scenes.sub: Maa Lakshmi aur Ganesh ji ki kripa aapke parivaar par bani rahe.

scenes.prompt: A colourful rangoli at a home doorway with many lit clay diyas, a new shining brass kalash and marigold flowers, warm golden festive night with soft bokeh lights
scenes.tts: ॐ धन्वंतरये नमः। धनतेरस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ।
scenes.sub: Om Dhanvantaraye Namah. Dhanteras ki haardik shubhkamnayein.

scenes.tts: अपने परिवार को भेजें। जय श्री श्याम!
scenes.sub: Apne parivaar ko bhejein. Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN. Jai Shree Shyam!
